paite: Huchibang in hiai mi thumte Job dawn atawpta ua, amah mit a diktat ahih ziak in.
heading: Elihu Thugen / (Job 32.1-37.24)
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

paite: Huai lai in Job tung ah Ram inkuan a Buz mi Barakel tapa Elihu hehna akuangkhia a, Pathian hi zaw lou a amah siam akitansak ziak in.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

paite: Alawm thumte tung ah leng ahehna akuangkhia a, dawnna ding nei lou a, hinapi a lah Job amohpaih ziak un.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

paite: Amah sang a a-upat zawk ziak un, Job kiang a thu gen ding in Elihu in angak hi.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.

paite: Hiai mi thumte kam a dawnna a-om kei chih atheih in, ahehna akuangkhia hi.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

paite: "Huchi in Buz mi Barakel tapa. Elihu in adawng hi: Ka naupang a, noute na upa mahmah uh; huaiziak in ka dai a, ka lungsim ka hon ensak ngam kei hi.
english: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

paite: Huchi in ka chi, 'Nite'n thu agen ding uh, kum tampi in pilna a sinsak ding hi.'
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

paite: Himahleh mihing lungsim a om a, Bangkim hihthei in theihsiamna apia hi.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.

paite: Apilte mithupite ahi kei ua, vaihawmna theisiamte upate ahi sam kei uh.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

paite: Huaiziak in hong ngaikhia un; ke'n leng ka lungsim ka ensak ding, ka chi.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

paite: "Ngai un, na thute uh ka ngak a, gen ding na zonkhiak lai un, na thusutte uh ka ngaikhia.
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

paite: Ahi, ka hon limsak a, ngai un, kuamah Job thuzoh zou na om kei uh, ahihkeileh na lak uah, athute dawng.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

paite: Pilna i muta, chi lou ding in pilvang un; mihing hilou in Pathian in amah azou thei hi.
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom, God may refute him, not man;’

paite: Ama'n kei siatna ding in athute ahih kei a; ke'n leng nou thugente in amah ka dawng sam kei ding.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

paite: "Lamdang sa in, adawng nawn akei ua, gen ding thu khat leng anei kei uh.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

paite: Thu ging neih louh ziak in adingh kinken ua, adawn nawn louh ziak un ke'n ka ngak diam?
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

paite: Ke'n leng ka dawnna ding ka nei hi, ka lungsim ka ensak sam ding, ka chi hi.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

paite: Thu in ka dim a; ka sung a ka kha in hon sawl teitei hi.
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

paite: Ngai un, ka gilpi pawtkhiakna nei lou uain thawl bang ahi; uain thawl thakte bang in puakzak ding in mansa in ma-om hi.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

paite: Ka halhtheihna ding in, ka pau ding; ka mukte ka hong dia, ka dawng ding hi.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

paite: Mihing mihinna zahtaksak kei un, ka hon ngen hi; kuamah kiang ah leng maitang phatna min ka pe kei ding hi.
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

paite: Maitang phatna minte piak ding ka thei ngal kei a; huchi lou in zaw kei hon bawlpa'n ahon lazok ding hi."
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles; or else my Maker would soon take me away.
